name: – Dainius Žalimas – § 2/2
title: REPORT on monitoring the application of European Union law in 2023, 2024 and 2025
part_text: ‘notes with concern that national constitutional and supreme courts in some Member States have been undermining the well-established doctrine of the primacy of EU law; stresses that such developments should always lead to swift enforcement activities by the Commission, including infringement procedures;’
